userCode = mckData[ 7, "X1_code.recall.control"]
parts <- strsplit(userCode, split = "\n")
userCodeVec = unlist(parts)


userCodeVec[1]
javaCode[1]

levDis = stringdist(userCodeVec[1], javaCode[1], method = "lv")


ldArray = array(dim = length(javaCode)) # array for inner loop
mapping = array(dim = length(javaCode))
ldList = array(dim = length(javaCode))
normalLDList =array(dim = length(javaCode))
matchedStimuli =array(0, dim = length(javaCode))
matchedUserCode =array(0, dim = length(userCodeVec))

#for each line in the java code
for(i in seq_along(javaCode))
{

  # for each line in the user code
  for(j in seq_along(userCodeVec))
  {
    print(javaCode[i])
    print(userCodeVec[j])
    # compare the line of java code to the user line and store in array using LD 
    #(smallest number means more similar)
    ldArray[j] = stringdist(javaCode[i], userCodeVec[j], method = "lv")
    print(ldArray)
    
  }
  print("end of inner loop")
  #the user code line with the smallest LD
  if(matchedStimuli[i] == 0 && matchedUserCode[i] ==0)
  {
     mapping[i] = which.min(ldArray)
     ldList[i] = ldArray[mapping[i]]
     max_len <- pmax(nchar(javaCode[i]), nchar(userCodeVec[j]))
     normalLDList[i] = ldList[i] / max_len
     
     matchedStimuli[i] = 1
     matchedUserCode[i] = 1 
  }
 
}
print(mapping)
print(ldList)
print(normalLDList)
print(matchedStimuli)
print(matchedUserCode)





missinglines = sum(matchedStimuli == 0 )
extralines = sum(matchedUserCode == 0 )

print(missinglines)
print(extralines)
